description: Ten unseen complex sentences T061-T070. GPT draft labels for main-clause school-grammar roles only. Not verified gold. Nested clauses and scope of modifiers require independent review; exact-match failure is diagnostic, not necessarily an engine error.

cases.text: Rarely have the researchers who developed the theory encountered such strong opposition.
cases.notes: Relative clause who developed the theory modifies researchers; exclude from main S.

cases.text: It remains unclear whether the evidence that the committee examined was sufficient to justify its decision.
cases.notes: Whether-clause is extraposed semantic subject; that the committee examined modifies evidence.

cases.text: Had the manager known how serious the problem was, she would have had the engineers examine the system immediately.

M: Had the manager known how serious the problem was

cases.notes: Immediately modifies examine, not main verb; subclause role must be evaluated separately.

cases.text: It was the proposal that the younger members had initially rejected that was eventually adopted by the board.
cases.notes: First that-clause modifies proposal; second that-clause is cleft focus clause.

cases.text: The discovery made it possible for scientists who had previously failed to detect the signal to identify its source.
cases.notes: It is formal object; for scientists ... to identify its source is semantic object/complement of possible.

cases.text: Difficult as the task may seem, it is far less complicated than most people initially assume.

M: Difficult as the task may seem

cases.notes: Degree words and comparative phrase segmentation provisional; school-grammar C may include less complicated.

cases.text: The negotiations having broken down, we watched the delegates who had supported the agreement leave the conference room in silence.
cases.notes: in silence belongs inside embedded complement, not matrix M; exclude relative clause from O.

cases.text: Whatever conclusions the investigators may reach, it does not necessarily follow that the original hypothesis was incorrect.

M: Whatever conclusions the investigators may reach

cases.notes: That-clause is extraposed semantic subject; whatever-clause is concessive.

cases.text: At the center of the controversy stood a scientist whose findings had been dismissed by experts who later acknowledged their significance.

M: At the center of the controversy

cases.notes: Two nested relatives should be excluded from matrix S.

cases.text: What made the researchers particularly concerned was the possibility that the results they had considered reliable might have been misleading.

expected.S: What made the researchers particularly concerned

cases.notes: Main S is free relative; appositive that-clause modifies possibility; embedded relative has object gap and C reliable.
